internal_hash_semantics: All native internal hashes bind original private bytes, including prompts, corpus text, service definitions and source artifacts. Resolve them through this ledger; never mistake them for hashes of redacted derivative text.
native_evidence_authority: Original private bytes are authoritative; every projection is a derivative and is not exact unmodified raw.
person_name_reproduction_gap: A single operator-name TTS case and associated transcript spellings are redacted. Original counts/metrics/hashes remain authoritative; the exact private-name prompt cannot be reconstructed from its public placeholder and is not claimed to be byte-identical.

redaction_location_encoding: Each projection redactions_by_operation maps the explicit operation to every affected JSON/text path. Repeated operation labels are grouped for size only; no location is omitted. Structural changes remain individually declared in changes.
redaction_policy: Remove operator personal names and ASR spelling variants, username, private host/UID, local endpoint/IP, home paths and secret references. Keep public repository@revision identities, native schemas, every request and failure, numeric metrics, boolean/null uncertainty and reasoning text except private identity. No weights/audio/private fixture source are copied.
status: final sanitized derivative selection; original private evidence retained; no promotion
structural_projection_policy: For TTS timing.chunks only, retain first and last originally captured size/timing events and hash the original array. Original chunk-count/retention/truncation fields describe PRIVATE capture and are not rescaled to the projected two-event list. Preserve first PCM/audio and body timing, source PCM/hash/frame geometry, response bytes/hash/complete/status, failures, controls and all request rows. Last captured event is not asserted to be EOF; native response.complete is the independent observed EOF/completeness boundary. Intermediate per-chunk gaps cannot be reconstructed from this derivative. STT alone adds an identical schema alias for the existing renderer. No TTS/LLM schema rewrite.
